name: L10 SEVN high-resolution address-door pixel canary
question: After one frozen evaluator-selected PAN or APPROACH observation, can a label-blind pixel pipeline find the requested house number and bind it to the correct visible door proposal on the same 24 SEVN episodes?

cohort.development_note: SEVN001 was used before freezing for one orientation, annotation-scale, OCR, and portal-threshold smoke check. The complete 24-episode panel is consumed Development and carries no held-out or generalization authority.

high_resolution_archive.access: Read and decode only the 24 action-result members directly from the ZIP; never extract the 4,988-panorama corpus.

action_control.selection_authority: Evaluator truth selects the already frozen scenario-designated action before inference.
action_control.runtime_observation: The pixel pipeline receives only the public mission house number and the rendered action-result pixels. It receives no SEVN door, text, address-match, visibility, or binding labels.
action_control.claim_boundary: This run tests pixel-derived address-to-door binding after a prescribed active observation. It does not test or claim learned action selection.

render_contract.source_projection: SEVN equirectangular panorama ring crop matching the official environment orientation convention
render_contract.crop_rounding: round center-minus-half-width using Python round, then modulo-index exactly 1440 columns
render_contract.why_not_legacy_1280_crop: A 1280-pixel crop from a 3840-pixel panorama is 120 degrees. This protocol preserves the already frozen 135-degree action contract with a 1440-pixel crop.

portal_model.license: AGPL-3.0; internal research only pending product-integration license review

ocr.backend: RapidOCR 3.9.2 / PP-OCRv6 small / ONNX Runtime CPUExecutionProvider

ocr.target_match: Case-insensitive exact alphanumeric token equality after deleting punctuation and spaces; no fuzzy aliases.

portal_model.postprocess: Unmodified model-card mirror suppression and doorway/door cross-class de-duplication; retain class 0 doorway and class 1 door only.

association.ranking: For every exact target-text and portal pair, minimize normalized Euclidean gap from the text center to the portal box, then prefer portal confidence, OCR confidence, and stable box coordinates.
association.abstention: No exact target token, no portal, or an excessive text-to-portal gap returns UNKNOWN.

evaluation.correct: The selected portal box center lies inside the scaled SEVN target-door annotation.
evaluation.wrong: A joined portal is selected but its center lies outside the target-door annotation.
evaluation.unknown: The pixel pipeline abstains before a joined portal proposal.

gate.interpretation: A bounded mechanism gate: at least one third of the full panel must produce correct pixel-derived target-door bindings, a majority of truth-visible signs must be read exactly, and wrong bindings remain rare.

retention_policy.keep: Protocol, evaluator, detailed result, hashes, source archive, and documentation decision.
retention_policy.delete: Any reconstructible extracted panorama, rendered viewport, thumbnail, debug overlay, decompression cache, or task temporary directory after the result is verified.
retention_policy.implementation: The formal evaluator streams ZIP members and writes no intermediate images; any pre-freeze smoke files are deleted separately after the run.

stop_rule: Run the frozen 24 episodes once. Do not change the crop, action map, models, thresholds, OCR match, association rule, scoring, or gate after observing the result. A successor must use a new protocol version.
